items.answer: A relevant map, scholarly/educator text, community source, historical document, or data record; source must match the claim. One point for suitable source and one for purpose.

items.prompt: Map a route of cultural/religious exchange.
items.answer: Rubric (3): accurate relevant content (1); supported comparison/relationship (1); clear organization and source/evidence awareness (1). Accurate broad regions, a plausible mechanism, and limits; distinguish exchange from universal acceptance.

practice.title: Computer Science
practice.passage: Coordinates locate positions with ordered values. On a standard plane, x is horizontal and y vertical. State units and scale when they matter.

items.prompt: What does changing x usually represent?
items.answer: A horizontal position change on a standard coordinate plane.

items.prompt: Plot sprite positions on graph paper and describe coordinate changes. Use precise vocabulary, two supporting reasons or observations, and a limitation.
items.answer: Look for a relevant completed activity, an accurate concept, evidence or an example, and a reasoned explanation/revision. Accept varied justified responses. Do not grade beliefs or private experiences.

practice.title: Life Skills
practice.passage: Physical activity includes play, dance, walking, and sports. Choose safe accessible movement with rest as needed. The goal is participation rather than comparing bodies.

items.prompt: Must activity be identical for everyone?
items.answer: No; activities can be adapted to abilities, needs, and space.

items.prompt: Plan and perform an adapted movement break with a parent, then record an adjustment. Use precise vocabulary, two supporting reasons or observations, and a limitation.
items.answer: Look for a relevant completed activity, an accurate concept, evidence or an example, and a reasoned explanation/revision. Accept varied justified responses. Do not grade beliefs or private experiences.
